speaker: NEWS
text: Good morning, Nexus City. Overnight, residents reported unusual lights over the harbor.

speaker: PLAYER
text: Another ordinary morning. That would be nice.

speaker: NEWS
text: Officials say there is no cause for alarm—

speaker: PLAYER
text: The windows are shaking.

speaker: NOVA
text: Neural resonance confirmed. Can you hear me?

speaker: PLAYER
text: Who is this?

speaker: NOVA
text: NOVA. Your building is destabilizing. Leave the apartment now.

speaker: PLAYER
text: What happened to the sky?

speaker: NOVA
text: A Fracture. Reality is intersecting with something it was never meant to touch.

speaker: PLAYER
text: There are people trapped in the hall.

speaker: NOVA
text: Then we help them. Move. I will guide you.

speaker: CIVILIAN
text: Please! The stairwell is blocked!

speaker: PLAYER
text: Get behind me. I think I can move this.

speaker: NOVA
text: That energy came from you. We will understand it later.

speaker: PLAYER
text: Later sounds good. Where is the exit?

speaker: CIVILIAN
text: My daughter is on the other side of that door!

speaker: PLAYER
text: Stay low. I am getting her out.

speaker: NOVA
text: Structural failure in twenty seconds. The support beam is shifting.

speaker: PLAYER
text: I can feel something in my hands.

speaker: NOVA
text: Focus on the beam. Do not fight the current; redirect it.

speaker: PLAYER
text: Everybody back!

speaker: CHILD
text: Mom?

speaker: CIVILIAN
text: Thank you. I thought we were gone.

speaker: PLAYER
text: Take the service stairs. Do not stop.

speaker: NOVA
text: You used a Fracture ability without an Operator interface. That should be impossible.

speaker: PLAYER
text: Then stop telling me what should be possible.

speaker: RADIO
text: Emergency services are asking residents to shelter indoors.

speaker: PLAYER
text: That advice is a little late.

speaker: NOVA
text: Three safe routes. Two are already changing.

speaker: PLAYER
text: Changing how?

speaker: NOVA
text: The road ahead now connects to a place that did not exist this morning.

speaker: SURVIVOR
text: Those things came out of the purple light!

speaker: PLAYER
text: Get to the transit station. I will hold them off.

speaker: NOVA
text: Remember: cover, movement, then ability. Survive first.

speaker: PLAYER
text: And if the street tears open again?

speaker: NOVA
text: Then we improvise.
